description.narrative: The project will promote social and economic inclusion and sustainable livelihoods of poor people and vulnerable groups by providing an agriculture service system, information technology for value chains, and information support to areas where rural poverty is still endemic. The main beneficiaries of the project will be members of cooperatives, small and medium-sized enterprises, and contracted farmers in the seven prefectures that comprise the project area: Baiyin, Dingxi, Jiuquan, Lanzhou, Tianshui, Wuwei, and Zhangye. The project will include design features to ensure that farmers have access to high-value e-commerce markets and thereby increase their income.

Output: Agricultural production, processing, storage, and marketing modernized Indicator: At least 118,700 mu of production area managed by PIUs and participating farmers become operational with access to comprehensive information service and management platform Progress/Status: The 5,000 mu high-standard corn seed production base of Subproject 2 has been integrated into the information platform. Output: Agricultural production, processing, storage, and marketing modernized Indicator: At least 17 project products have access to e-commerce platform Achievement: 7 Progress/Status: Seven project products manufactured by Sub-project 3, namely freeze-dried lemons, freeze-dried broccoli, strawberries, yogurt chunks, mangoes, yellow peaches, and juicy peaches, have been launched for sale on the Alibaba platform. Data Source: Results of participants survey

Output: Agricultural production, processing, storage, and marketing modernized Indicator: At least 22,000 farmers receive technical and management support services through comprehensive information service and management platform Progress/Status: Due to the provincial comprehensive information service and management platform has not put into use yet, the progress is lagging behind. Output: Agricultural production, processing, storage, and marketing modernized Indicator: At least 90% of project processing facilities monitor raw material quality through comprehensive information service and management platform Achievement: 90 Progress/Status: The processing facilities under this project refer to primary/deep processing facilities, including the vegetable freeze-drying and drying lines in Subproject 3. Currently, the IoT facilities in the standardized production bases of Subprojects 3 are operational and can monitor quality in the seedling and planting stages. Therefore, the current result for this indicator is 100%.
Data Source: Results of participants survey

Output: Agricultural production, processing, storage, and marketing modernized Indicator: Chemical fertilizer application reduced by 40% Achievement: 40 Progress/Status: Completion Rate: 100% Integrated water and fertilizer facilities are in use at the bases of Subprojects 3 with good results. Based on interviews and surveys with the PIUs, measures like unified prevention and control, soil testing and customized fertilization, and integrated water and fertilizer management have reduced fertilizer use by about 55% and pesticide use by 35% compared to 2019.
Data Source: Results of participants survey

Output: Agricultural production, processing, storage, and marketing modernized Indicator: Crop value per hectare increased by at least 5% for farm households supplying products to PIUs Achievement: 5 Progress/Status: Local pork purchased by Subproject 2 is about 4% higher than the market price, and Jujube are about 11% higher. For Subproject 3, broccoli is about 36% higher and baby cabbage is about 16% higher. Overall, the value-added exceeds 5%. Data Source: Results of participants survey
